# Scale

> Scale constructor.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var Scale = require( '@stdlib/plot/vega/scale/base/ctor' );
```

#### Scale( options )

Returns a scale instance.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});
// returns <Scale>
```

The constructor accepts the following `options`:

-   **domain**: domain of associated data values.
-   **domainMax**: maximum value in the scale domain (overrides the `domain` option).
-   **domainMin**: minimum value in the scale domain (overrides the `domain` option).
-   **domainMid**: single mid-point value inserted into a two-element domain.
-   **domainRaw**: array of raw domain values which overrides the `domain` property.
-   **interpolate**: scale range interpolation method.
-   **name**: scale name.
-   **range**: scale range.
-   **reverse**: boolean indicating whether to reverse the order of the scale range. Default: `false`.
-   **round**: boolean indicating whether to round numeric output values to integers. Default: `false`.
-   **type**: scale type. Default: `'linear'`.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale',
    'domain': [ 0, 100 ],
    'type': 'log'
});
// returns <Scale>

var v = scale.type;
// returns 'log'
```

* * *

### Writable Properties

<a name="prop-domain"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.domain

Scale domain.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

// Set:
scale.domain = [ 0, 100 ];

// Get:
var v = scale.domain;
// returns [ 0, 100 ]
```

<a name="prop-domain-max"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.domainMax

Explicit scale domain maximum value.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

// Set:
scale.domainMax = 100;

// Get:
var v = scale.domainMax;
// returns 100
```

<a name="prop-domain-min"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.domainMin

Explicit scale domain minimum value.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

// Set:
scale.domainMin = 0;

// Get:
var v = scale.domainMin;
// returns 0
```

<a name="prop-domain-mid"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.domainMid

Mid-point inserted into a two-element scale domain.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

// Set:
scale.domainMid = 50;

// Get:
var v = scale.domainMid;
// returns 50
```

<a name="prop-domain-raw"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.domainRaw

Raw scale domain values.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

// Set:
scale.domainRaw = [ 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ];

// Get:
var v = scale.domainRaw;
// returns [ 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ]
```

<a name="prop-interpolate"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.interpolate

Scale range interpolation method.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

// Set:
scale.interpolate = 'rgb';

// Get:
var v = scale.interpolate;
// returns 'rgb'
```

<a name="prop-name"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.name

Scale name.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

// Set:
scale.name = 'yScale';

// Get:
var v = scale.name;
// returns 'yScale'
```

<a name="prop-range"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.range

Scale range.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

// Set:
scale.range = [ 0, 100 ];

// Get:
var v = scale.range;
// returns [ 0, 100 ]
```

<a name="prop-reverse"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.reverse

Boolean indicating whether to reverse the order of the scale range. Default: `false`.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

// Set:
scale.reverse = true;

// Get:
var v = scale.reverse;
// returns true
```

<a name="prop-round"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.round

Boolean indicating whether to round numeric output value to integers. Default: `false`.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

// Set:
scale.round = true;

// Get:
var v = scale.round;
// returns true
```

<a name="prop-type"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.type

Scale type. Default: `'linear'`.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

// Set:
scale.type = 'log';

// Get:
var v = scale.type;
// returns 'log'
```

* * *

### Read-only Properties

<a name="prop-properties"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.properties

List of enumerable properties.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

var v = scale.properties;
// returns [ 'domain', 'domainMax', 'domainMin', 'domainMid', 'domainRaw', 'interpolate', 'name', 'range', 'reverse', 'round', 'type' ]
```

* * *

### Methods

<a name="method-to-json"></a>

#### Scale.prototype.toJSON()

Serializes a scale instance to a JSON object.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

var v = scale.toJSON();
// returns { 'name': 'xScale', 'reverse': false, 'round': false, 'type': 'linear' }
```

This method is implicitly invoked by `JSON.stringify`.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

var str = JSON.stringify( scale );
// returns '{"name":"xScale","reverse":false,"round":false,"type":"linear"}'
```

* * *

### Events

#### 'change'

Emitted whenever a property value changes.

```javascript
var scale = new Scale({
    'name': 'xScale'
});

scale.on( 'change', onChange );

scale.type = 'log';

function onChange( event ) {
    console.log( 'Updated property: %s', event.property );
}
```
